item.title: Cleveland State men go cold, drop 82-74 decision at IU Indy
item.description: The Cleveland State men’s five-game winning streak ended Feb. 7 with an 82-74 loss to host IU Indy. The Vikings (10-15, 6-8 Horizon) fell behind by 18 in the first eight minutes of the game. After making a school-record 17 3-pointers in a win over Oakland on Feb. 4, they managed 8-of-35 shooting from long range against Indy. Dayan Nessah paced Cleveland State with 24 points. CSU plays its next two games at home, beginning Feb. 12 against Robert Morris.

item.title: Monsters drop 4-1 decision at Laval; Del Bel Belluz heads to All-Star Classic
item.description: The Monsters fell behind by three goals in the first 26 minutes and lost, 4-1, on Feb. 7 at Laval. AHL All-Star Luca Del Bel Belluz scored Cleveland’s goal, giving him six straight games with at least one point. He has 13 goals and 37 points this season. Both are team-highs. Zach Sawchenko made 21 saves in the Monsters’ net. Cleveland (29-14-2-2) dropped both games in the weekend series in Canada. The Monsters had won six in a row before the setbacks.
